description: Operational lessons that apply across repositories: global and role-scoped memories that every query in every scenario can see.

memories.text: Run one heavy job at a time on the shared build host, and check uptime before starting a large build or test run.
The build machine stalls when two heavy builds overlap; look at the load average first and run builds one at a time.
A reviewer only reads: no edits, commits, stashes or branch switches in the workspace it shares with the author.
Commit each working step as it lands, so a retry after a timeout builds on it instead of starting over.
An agent hit HTTP 429 from the model provider at 14:02 on 2026-10-01 and its turn was retried.
/tmp filled up during the 2026-10-03 test run because a build cache had been copied there.
Workers default to the model named model-a-2025 unless the task names another.
The default worker model is whatever config.toml sets under [models] default; it is not hard-coded.

queries.query: Run the full test suite and the benchmarks for the playbook scripts.
Review the committed change on the branch and report findings.
Implement the export command; the task may time out and be retried.
Which model do workers use by default when the task does not name one?

task.question: Where is the default worker model set? Answer with the file name only.
